page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal notes in the right margin: four notes at the top (keyed d and e), and one marginal heading "Casus 58" beside the commutatio paragraph. A catchword at the lower right of the text column. Printed page number and running head at the top.

main_text.l: Sic isti Cadmei fratres, dum se mutuis i-
nis suæ rationem afferre valent, causam
que nec Papæ, nec Principi, nec Synodo,
nec Senatui, nec ulli Præl ato vel Ecclesi-
astico vel seculari jus esse in sæderibus,
di, aut quenquam a vinculo quo ante fa-
proxima est ei affinis de juramenti com-
men indicat) nihil aliud quàm translatio
obligationis ab unâ materiâ ad aliam;
quæ sive major, sive minor, sive æquiva-
lens, videtur esse aliquo respectu com-
cies a suo Genere, vel Pars a suo Toto.
si enim sufficeret ad solvendum vinculum

page.notes: Marginal heading "Casus 58" in italic at the right, beside "commutatione". Note d and e numbers are small and partly unclear: "II.num.13" read as uncertain.
